components.name: Double Frame
components.description: The logo double frame with construction lines.
components.css: .ds-h{position:relative;margin:9px 30px;padding:20px;border:2px solid #1e9bf0;outline:1px solid #1e9bf0;outline-offset:6px;background:#070b10;color:#f2f5f8;font-family:Jost, system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-h::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-9px -30px;border-top:1px solid rgba(242,245,248,.38);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,245,248,.38)}.ds-h span{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.16em}.ds-h b{display:block;margin-top:10px;font:600 46px/1 Jost, system-ui, sans-serif}

components.name: Ruled Grid Cell
components.description: A figure under its label in capitals.
components.css: .ds-t{padding:13px 0 12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(242,245,248,.38);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,245,248,.38);color:#f2f5f8;font-family:Jost, system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-t span{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.14em}.ds-t b{display:block;margin-top:5px;font:600 26px/1.1 Jost, system-ui, sans-serif}

narrative.overview: An architect drawing of the station, in the look of the owner NANO Build site and the blue of the MTG logo: lines, frames and figures, nothing soft.
keyCharacteristics: Frames of 2px and the logo double frame
Titles announced by a drawn line

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only colour of the interface; one solid blue button per region.

rules.name: The Red Rule
rules.body: Red means owed, lost or destructive.

dos: Draw with lines: a frame, a rule, the grid
One solid blue button per region
Keep night and light in step
donts: No glass, blur, gradient, rounded corner or soft shadow
No Apple logo, name or imagery
